name: Manage Display Fix Title
description: Workaround for core bugs in display of entity title
project_description:
This project makes base fields such as 'title' available in "Manage Display".

 This very simple module uses the framework that is already in Core rather than inventing anything new. The goal is that most or all of this module will be absorbed into core [#2353867].

 Please see the documentation guide for details.

 It's currently not possible to manage display of the title field on node pages /node/XXX due to a Core limitation (and similar for labels of other entities). Please see [#3143678] for explanation and workarounds. Assistance with fixing welcome.
